title: Dwight’s Speech
one_paragraph_synopsis: Dwight prepares and delivers an enthusiastic speech at a sales convention, emphasizing the importance of defending the revolution and uniting salespeople. Michael supports Dwight's efforts, offering to teach him public speaking skills to prevent embarrassment. The episode also features Dwight's personal ambitions, including travel plans, and humorous interactions among colleagues, culminating in Dwight's passionate on-stage performance.
